shared_or_similar_visual_information: Filled circular marker on a curve
mathematical_meanings: Left image: A closed-endpoint marker indicating that the left endpoint belongs to this segment of the function graph. Right image: A special-position marker identifying a peak of the waveform whose coordinates can be read.
Rationales: The left marker encodes endpoint inclusion, whereas the right marker highlights an interior coordinate position; an interior marker should not be interpreted as a domain endpoint.
